items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Rose Tizol came with us on the tour, and she was worried about me, because she was a dear person, wonderful

ctx.x: So you had a really good rapport with the band – the guys in the band.

It was beautiful. Every guy in that band was beautiful. It’s a family. It was a family band. We shared everything. Even on that tour. You were asking about that tour, Big Show of 1951? The three main characters were Duke Ellington’s band, Sarah Vaughan, and Nat “King” Cole. That was really segregated. We played all those places down South. Birmingham, Alabama, was the first one. They still had all the signs up. “Colored only.” “White only.” So I would hang out with the band. I’d be eating next to Nat “King” Cole…
